description: Maps every spec leaf section to the tests, packages, schemas, migrations, and chart templates that encode it. Maintained alongside code: every PR that touches spec/, pkg/, schemas/, migrations/, or charts/lenny/ updates this file. CI runs `lenny-test validate-maps`.

3.title: High-Level Architecture
3.notes: Non-normative. Architecture diagram only. No tests required.

4.4.title: Event / Checkpoint Store
4.4.notes: Phase 8 ships the §4.4 checkpoint enums (Level, Trigger, Outcome, ResumeMode) plus the per-level consistency tag, the per-trigger retry budget, the §4.4 60-second quiescence timeout constant, the §4.4 'Hard workspace size limit' pre-check, and the §4.4 'Checkpoint freshness SLO' check. The MinIO upload pipeline, the SIGSTOP/SIGCONT embedded-adapter path, the eviction-fallback Postgres minimal-state record, and the lenny-drain-readiness admission webhook are deferred to the K8s-integration phase.

4.6.title: Pod Lifecycle Controllers
4.6.notes: Phase 3 ships the §4.6.2 scaling strategy (pkg/controller/poolscaling/strategy) as a unit-testable package. The full WarmPoolController and PoolScalingController binaries are deferred to the K8s-integration phase that brings up envtest and the Kind harness.

4.6.2.title: PoolScalingController — Pool Configuration
4.6.2.notes: Phase 3 ships the PoolScalingStrategy interface and the DefaultStrategy implementing §4.6.2 (standard, mode-adjusted, variant pool, adjusted base pool) plus the bootstrap fallback. The controller binary that wires the strategy to Postgres / Kubernetes is deferred to the K8s-integration phase.

4.6.1.title: Warm Pool Controller — Pod Lifecycle
4.6.1.notes: ADR-007: SandboxClaim optimistic-locking + failover fencing. Phase 1 shipped the state machine; Phase 3.5 ships the admission-decision logic in pkg/admission/sandboxclaim_guard. The webhook binary (HTTP+AdmissionReview transport) and the Kind-based admission integration test are deferred to the K8s-integration phase.

4.6.3.title: CRD Field Ownership and Write Boundaries
4.6.3.notes: Phase 3.5 ships the §4.6.3 ownership matrix as a Go-callable validator. The Kubernetes Server-Side Apply field-manager enforcement is the primary control in production; this package mirrors the matrix so admission-webhook decisions and audit tooling can reason about ownership without round-tripping through the API server.

4.9.title: Credential Leasing Service
4.9.notes: Phase 5.5 ships the §4.9 Provider, AssignmentStrategy, LeaseSource, and RotationTrigger enums plus the §4.7 ceiling-applicable rule and the §4.9 proactive-renewal budget-exclusion rule as Go-callable methods. The full Credential Leasing Service binary (Token Service binding, KMS rotation, materializedConfig schemas, the CredentialRenewalWorker) is deferred to the K8s-integration phase that ships the Token Service.

5.2.title: Pool Configuration and Execution Modes
5.2.notes: Phase 3.5 ships the §5.2 NET-003 / §17.2 item 5 label-immutability admission-decision logic. The webhook binary that wires this to AdmissionReview transport and the Kind-based admission integration test are deferred to the K8s-integration phase.

8.2.title: Delegation Mechanism — cycle detection and maxDepth
8.2.notes: Phase 9 ships the §8.2 cycle-detection three-layer AND gate (CycleMode enum + Decide function), the §8.2 LeaseSlice budget arithmetic with parent-ceiling validation, and the §8.2.bis maxDepth precedence chain (explicit > preset > runtime > policy > Helm fallback). The Redis Lua scripts (budget_reserve.lua, budget_return.lua) and the §8.2 delegate_task gateway handler are deferred to the K8s-integration phase that ships the delegation-echo runtime.

9.2.title: Elicitation Chain
9.2.notes: Phase 10 ships the §9.2 elicitation primitives: the EnforcementMode strict ordering (off < detect-only < enforce) and platform-floor clamp; the DepthPolicy with connector-exempt suppression; the InitiatorType enum; the canonicalised SHA-256 content digest used by the gateway-origin-binding tamper detector; the Provenance metadata validator. The hop-by-hop elicitation chain dispatcher, the URL-mode allowlist evaluator, the maxElicitationWait timer, the respond_to_elicitation authorization triple, and the §11.7 audit / §16.1 metric emissions are all wired by the gateway binary.

10.2.title: Authentication
10.2.notes: Phase 4.5 ships the §10.2 typ enum, RBAC role enum, tenant_id format validator, and the tenant-claim extraction state machine. The JWTSigner (KMS-backed in production, HMAC-SHA256 in dev mode), the OIDC discovery layer, and the signature-validation chain are deferred to the K8s-integration phase that wires the gateway to a real OIDC provider.

10.3.title: mTLS PKI
10.3.notes: Phase 3 ships the SPIFFE-URI parser and the in-memory certificate deny list. The cert-manager integration, the Helm-rendered Certificate resources, the Redis pub/sub fan-out of deny-list entries, and the e2e mTLS enforcement test on Kind are deferred to the K8s-integration phase.

10.5.title: Upgrade and Rollback Strategy
10.5.notes: Phase 3 ships the RuntimeUpgrade state machine from §10.5 (Pending → Expanding → Draining → Contracting → Complete, with Paused as a side-state). The lenny-ctl admin command surface and the SandboxTemplate-CRD interaction land with the K8s-integration phase. Schema-migration runbook tooling is covered by the Phase 1.5 migration framework.

10.6.title: Environment Resource and RBAC Model
10.6.notes: Phase 15 ships the §10.6 Role enum (viewer, creator, operator, admin) with the AtLeast escalation order, the K8s-style LabelSelector evaluator (matchLabels + matchExpressions with In/NotIn/Exists/DoesNotExist), the §10.6 types filter, and the include/exclude override semantics (exclude beats include for deterministic deny precedence). The admin API surface (POST /v1/admin/environments, etc.), the transparent-filtering middleware, the explicit-environment endpoint dispatcher, the OIDC-group resolver, and the cross-environment delegation policy resolver are deferred to the K8s-integration phase.

10.7.title: Experiment Primitives
10.7.notes: Phase 16 ships the §10.7 experiment primitives: Status / TargetingMode / Sticky / Propagation enums, the Definition admission validator (reserved control id, Σ weights < 1, duplicate-id check), and the HMAC-SHA256 percentage-mode bucketing algorithm. The ExperimentRouter interceptor wiring, the OpenFeature/OFREP external-targeting integration, the variant pool minWarm coupling in the PoolScalingController, and the admin API surface are deferred to the K8s-integration phase.

11.2.title: Budgets and Quotas
11.2.notes: Phase 5.75 ships the §11.2 quota arithmetic primitives: ResetPeriod enum, 80%/100% threshold checks, global→tenant→user hierarchical check, the §11.2 Maximum Overshoot Formula's fail-open ceiling, and the MAX-rule reconciliation function for Redis recovery. The Redis Lua scripts (storage_quota_reserve.lua, the per-replica fail-open accounting, the cumulative fail-open timer) and the gateway's quota Redis client are deferred to the K8s-integration phase.

11.5.title: Idempotency
11.5.notes: Phase 7 ships the §11.5 idempotency primitives: 128-character key cap, tenant-scoped Key shape, SHA-256 body hashing, 24-hour TTL constant, and the DetectReuse action resolver (store_new | replay | reject) that maps same-key-different-body to the *ReuseError 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED envelope. The Postgres-backed idempotency_keys table, the GC job, and the HTTP/MCP transport handlers (Idempotency-Key header / idempotencyKey field) are deferred to the K8s-integration phase.

11.6.title: Circuit Breakers
11.6.notes: Phase 7 ships the §11.6 operator-managed circuit-breaker admission logic: State enum, LimitTier enum (runtime/pool/connector/operation_type), OperationType enum, per-tier Scope validator, Match function, and the §11.6 immutable-scope invariant via ScopeMatches. The Redis-backed cache with pub/sub propagation, the admin API handlers, the 5-second cache-stale fallback path, and the §11.6 sampling-under-breaker-storms audit emitter are all deferred to the K8s-integration phase that ships the gateway and Redis.

11.7.title: Audit Logging
11.7.notes: Phase 13 ships the §11.7 audit-log enums (ChainIntegrity, ComplianceProfile, OCSFTranslationState) and the §16.4 RetentionPreset → days mapping with the compliance-profile compatibility matrix. The audit-log row writer, the per-tenant Postgres advisory lock, the SIEM forwarder, the OCSF translator, and the audit_log_deferred_writes reconciliation flow are deferred to the K8s-integration phase that ships the gateway and lenny-ops.

12.1.title: Storage Design Principle
12.1.notes: Non-normative principles. Enforced by §12.2 and §12.3 tests.

12.3.title: Postgres HA Requirements (R-01, R-02, R-03)
12.3.notes: Phase 1.5 ships R-01 (lint-schema.sh) and R-02 (lint-queries.sh) as static-tier linters. R-03 (StoreRouter for billing/audit) is verified by integration tests that land alongside the Postgres-backed store implementations in later phases.

13.1.title: Pod Security
13.1.notes: Phase 14 ships the §13.1 pod-spec validator: every host-sharing flag forbidden (shareProcessNamespace, hostPID, hostNetwork, hostIPC → POD_SPEC_HOST_SHARING_FORBIDDEN), pod-level fsGroup = lenny-cred-readers GID (POD_SPEC_CRED_FSGROUP_MISSING), pod-level runAsNonRoot=true, per-container allowPrivilegeEscalation=false / privileged=false / readOnlyRootFilesystem=true / capabilities.drop=[ALL] / capabilities.add=[]. The Kubernetes admission webhook that wraps this validator and the lenny-preflight startup hard-fail are deferred to the K8s-integration phase.

13.3.title: Credential Flow
13.3.notes: Phase 12a ships the §13.3 RFC 8693 token-exchange invariants as a pure Validate function: scope narrowing (subject ⊆), tenant-scope (issued.tenant_id == subject.tenant_id == caller.tenant_id), caller_type cannot elevate (agent < service < human), audience cannot broaden, typ rules (a2a_delegation only via actor_token), delegation_depth = parent+1 on child minting, exp = min(requested, subject.exp, actor.exp, perDialectCap) with the §13.3 ±1s skew and Unix-seconds truncation per RFC 7519. The Postgres-backed write-before-issue transaction, the KMS signing path, the cluster-wide revocation propagation via Redis EventBus, and the Token Service binary are deferred to the K8s-integration phase.

13.4.title: Upload Security
13.4.notes: Phase 13.4 ships the §13.4 archive-validator constants (MaxDecompressedSize 256MiB, MaxDecompressionRatio 100:1, MaxEntryCount 10000, MaxPerEntrySize 64MiB, MaxPathDepth 32, MaxPathLength 4096) and the §13.4 invariants: per-entry kind check (hardlink/char-device/block-device/FIFO/socket rejected), path traversal rejection including absorbed `..` segments, depth and length caps, symlink default-deny with the §13.4 workspace-root + `/proc` / `/sys` / `/dev` / `/run/lenny` escape check. Reason sub-codes match the §16.1 lenny_upload_extraction_aborted_total{error_type} labels exactly. The streaming-extraction harness, the staging→validation→promotion pattern, and the post-promotion symlink re-validation are deferred to the gateway phase.

15.1.title: REST API
15.1.notes: Phase 4 ships: (1) pkg/api/v1/session §15.1 state enum + precondition validator (Go-callable); (2) pkg/gateway/sessionstore Store interface and memstore in-memory backend with tenant isolation; (3) pkg/gateway/sessionserver http.Handler implementing POST /v1/sessions, GET, GET /v1/sessions/{id}, DELETE, and the five state-mutating transitions (finalize, start, interrupt, terminate, resume) — each enforces §15.1 preconditions via session.Validate and emits the INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION envelope on rejection; (4) cmd/lenny-gateway minimal binary boots the handler against memstore. Tier-3 contract tests drive the handler via httptest. The Postgres-backed store, OIDC auth middleware, workspace materialization, upload pipeline, derive/replay flows, OpenAPI document, and the §11.6 admission controller wiring are deferred to later phases — the handler surface is store-agnostic, so swapping memstore for the production store leaves the contract tests unchanged.

15.4.title: Runtime Adapter Specification
15.4.notes: Phase 1 ships the wire-contract artifacts. Phase 2 ships the Basic-level echo runtime (cmd/runtimes/echo) and the conformance harness (cmd/lenny-compliance). Phase 2.8 ships the Full-level streaming-echo runtime, the lifecycle-events JSON Schema, and the --level full conformance battery (lifecycle handshake, checkpoint quiesce/resume, interrupt acknowledgement, credentials_rotated, deadline_signal). Standard-level tests (tool-call correlation, adapter-local tools) and the gateway-side response-shorthand normalisation are skipped until the relevant runtimes ship in later phases.

15.4.3.title: Runtime Integration Levels — Full
15.4.3.notes: Phase 2.8 ships the Full-level reference runtime and the lifecycle-events schema. Full-level features (lifecycle channel, checkpoint, interrupt, credential rotation, deadline signal) are exercised via the lenny-compliance --level full battery.

15.4.6.title: Conformance Test Suite
15.4.6.notes: Phase 2.8 extends the conformance harness with the Full-level test categories from §15.4.6. The harness runs a Unix-socket lifecycle-channel server, points the runtime at it via the LENNY_ADAPTER_MANIFEST env var, and asserts each lifecycle event round-trip. Standard-level categories ship in Phase 9 alongside delegation-echo.

6.3.title: Startup Latency Analysis
6.3.notes: Phase 2 ships the startup-latency benchmark harness and the first Basic-level baseline (heartbeat round-trip). Subsequent phases extend the harness with pod-warm vs SDK-warm comparisons and a Full-level checkpoint duration baseline.

18.1.title: ImageResolver build artifact
18.1.notes: ImageResolver enforces override > url > default precedence and digest pinning. Spec §18 (build sequence) is currently deferred; this entry captures the §18.1 deliverable named by the prior spec revision.

15.5.title: API Versioning and Stability
15.5.notes: Phase 1 ships only the proto's NegotiateVersion RPC envelope and the schemaVersion fields on WorkspacePlan, OutputPart, and MessageEnvelope. The REST/MCP version-negotiation contract (URL prefixes, deprecation headers, 6-month sunset rule) is a Phase 5 deliverable; tests land alongside the API implementation.

16.1.title: Metrics
16.1.notes: Phase 2.5 ships the label-hygiene validator that enforces §16.1.1 high-cardinality rules and the typed Counter/Gauge/Histogram constructors. The full metrics catalog (lenny_warmpool_idle_pods, lenny_session_startup_duration_seconds, etc.) lands incrementally with each feature that emits the metric.

16.3.title: Distributed Tracing
16.3.notes: Phase 2.5 ships the correlation context, the OTel tracer wrapper with the §16.3 span catalog, and the §16.3 error taxonomy. Trace propagation through actual gateway/pod/controller binaries lands with each component.

16.4.title: Logging
16.4.notes: Phase 2.5 ships the slog handler that auto-attaches correlation fields. Per-component log emission (gateway, lenny-ops, etc.) lands with each component.

16.5.title: Alerting Rules and SLOs
16.5.notes: Phase 2.5 ships the typed Rule, the PromQL validator, and a representative catalog (WarmPoolExhausted, PostgresReplicationLagHigh, CredentialPoolLow, WarmPoolLow, CertExpiryImminent). The full §16.5 catalog lands incrementally with each feature that emits the underlying metric.

18.title: Build Sequence
18.notes: Non-normative. The implementation phases drive the test sequence in TESTING.md §13.

19.title: Resolved Decisions
19.notes: Each entry maps to an ADR under docs/adr/. Tests are attached to the relevant feature section.
